issue.title: test_load_config_ignores_retired_sdd_selectors fails under the full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Reproduction: just test-scoped (part of just check) failed this node under the full parallel lane while running tests/llm_provider/test_load_balanced_alias_defaults.py etc. for an unrelated change (restoring Gemini 3.7 Flash High to @xsmall only, plan restore_gemini_xsmall_only.md). Isolated rerun: .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_config.py::test_load_config_ignores_retired_sdd_selectors passes alone. This matches the known parallel-lane-only flake pattern (see closed retired-umbrella bead sase-ct and open node-specific bead sase-mv for the same mechanism on a different test node) rather than a defect in the Gemini/model-alias change under test. Scope: identify the shared/global state this test races on under xdist parallel execution and fix or isolate it.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired umbrella for the same class of full-parallel-lane-only ACE/config test flakes; do not +1 it.
RELATED: sase-mv — same mechanism (fails under full parallel lane, passes in isolation) on a different test node.
